implementation_changes.change: Add required allowed_tools: frozenset[str] to Broker; require it is a non-empty subset of TOOL_NAMES. In call(), refuse name not in allowed_tools before charging uncertainty. Filter definitions(allowed_tools) so tools/list exposes only that subset. Keep run_command/fetch_source semantics unchanged when permitted. Compatibility: callers must pass allowed_tools; omitting it is a hard Refused, not a silent default to all tools.
implementation_changes.rationale: Observed packet_violation used run_command under a no-run-command brief because TOOL_NAMES were unconditionally offered; fail-closed tool binding prevents that class of waste without weakening receipt provenance.

implementation_changes.change: Read packet['job']['allowed_tools'] (validated upstream), pass into Broker(..., allowed_tools=...). Build provider_config allow list strictly as mcp__foundry__{n} for n in allowed_tools only; keep NATIVE_DENY unchanged and verbatim. Before execute_scoped, compute deny_sha256=digest(encoded(NATIVE_DENY)) and allow_sha256=digest(encoded(sorted(allow))), write both into transport prelude fields via a small preflight dict recorded on the attempt; refuse if recomputed config bytes diverge from what will be written. Compatibility: jobs without allowed_tools fail before launch_entered; no auth/config/autonomy flag changes.
implementation_changes.rationale: Foreign native read/exec despite deny rules and omitted-transcript vs broker receipts are post-hoc; pinning and narrowing the offered MCP surface before launch cuts wasted SWE-2 calls and keeps deny policy mechanically auditable.

implementation_changes.change: In native plan validation (v3 jobs), require each job has allowed_tools: list[str] unique, subset of TOOL_NAMES, and consistent with any explicit brief constraint tokens already present in the job schema if the plan carries tool_policy (e.g. forbid run_command when policy says so). In run_one, after packet.json is written and workspace_files(packet) succeeds, call a new preflight_packet_tools(packet) that re-checks allowed_tools binding and dependency path scope; any Refused here must occur with launch_entered=false so reservations are failed not unknown. Compatibility: v2 projected validation unchanged; v3 plans gain one required job field—old plans refuse at init rather than launch.
implementation_changes.rationale: Converts brief/policy mismatches into blocked/failed before provider spend; preserves unknown-only-after-launch_entered semantics already in run_one.

implementation_changes.change: When assembling the worker packet, copy job['allowed_tools'] into packet['job'] verbatim and include citation-stable tool_policy digest in the packet so receipt.packet_sha256 binds the allowlist. Do not infer allowlists from free-text brief alone beyond the structured field; brief text remains non-authoritative. Compatibility: packet_sha256 changes for new campaigns only; historical attempts untouched.
implementation_changes.rationale: Durable packet identity must include the tool allowlist so report/verify_attempt_artifacts and collect_filing correspondence stay fail-closed against drift.
implementation_changes.symbol: packet_for (or adjacent packet builder used by foundry.run)

implementation_changes.change: No softening: keep sorted(export mcp calls)==sorted(broker observed) as Refused; keep foreign/native tools and model_name drift as Refused before CompletedFailure; keep CompletedFailure only for post-qualification filing/schema/citation defects. Optionally add an explicit error substring when export omits broker-present calls (still Refused). Compatibility: behavior already matches gate candidate; change is assertion message clarity only if tests need it—do not reclassify divergence as CompletedFailure.
implementation_changes.rationale: Wave08 broker_divergence and foreign_tool_failure must stay capacity-holding/fail-closed; CompletedFailure salvage applies only after execution qualification, as already tested.

implementation_changes.change: Add focused tests: (1) Broker refuses run_command when allowed_tools excludes it and does not mark uncertain; (2) definitions()/MCP tools/list omit disallowed tools; (3) packet missing allowed_tools refused before mocked provider launch; (4) preflight deny/allow digest mismatch refuses with launch_entered false; (5) existing foreign-tool and receipt-divergence cases remain Refused not CompletedFailure. Keep LinuxToolsTests unchanged. Compatibility: extend broker() helper to pass full TOOL_NAMES by default so legacy tests keep behavior.
implementation_changes.rationale: Tier-1 fast gate must be deterministic unittest coverage inside construction_swarm; proves policy binding without provider calls.

implementation_changes.change: Document Tier A (per focused commit): unittest discover on touched modules + ruff + packet/plan dry-validate + allowed_tools preflight mocks; no Devin launch; no coordinator synthesis. Tier B (publication only): exact Windows 70/7-skip + WSL 70/1-skip + ruff + diff-check + source pycompile matching current_gate. State that model/coordinator output is advisory evidence under validate_synthesis dispositions review|blocked never accepted authority; unknowns never auto-refund. Compatibility: docs-only; no operational auth changes.
implementation_changes.rationale: Gives Sol an immediate operating sequence for large Devin-first waves while limiting Codex synthesis to post-return batches with unknown barriers intact.
implementation_changes.symbol: Two-tier gate workflow section (new subsection only)

design.summary: Wave08 burned provider slots on packet/tool-policy drift that deterministic preflight can refuse before launch_entered: bind each job to an explicit allowed_tools subset, filter MCP definitions and Broker.dispatch to that set, hash-pin NATIVE_DENY/allow config before client start, and split gates into a fast deterministic tier per focused change plus the existing exact Windows/WSL full gate only at publication. CompledFailure for post-qualification filing defects stays; foreign tools, transcript/broker divergence, model drift, and cleanup uncertainty remain Refused/unknown with no provenance salvage. Coordinators stay advisory via validate_synthesis (review/blocked only).
